site.name: Taipei Main Station forecourts
site.basis: The photographed approaches have ordinary curb and step heights. Standard Terrarium gives 5.704 m and 5.923 m at the west and northwest outdoor controls, with an elevated 27.725 m return on the south plaza. The bounded 5.80 m visualization grade covers the headhouse and its immediate street approaches and blends back to the host field.

limits: The local visualization grade removes high urban returns in the global Terrarium data. The exterior threshold, bed heights and roof proportions are photographic and terrain-based estimates, with a smooth transition to the host field.
The modeled headhouse uses the mapped 30 m height and 18 m roof-height tags as coarse controls. The visible eaves, roof levels and communications frames are reconstructed from photos.
The independent MRT entrances, bus shelters and surrounding buildings retain their map-derived geometry. Exact lettering, rooftop equipment and navigable interiors are outside this exterior model.
